name: @aparadeckav2/tooling
description: Root tooling shell: git hooks (husky + lint-staged) and repo-wide dependency scripts. Studio and web remain independent packages with their own lockfiles.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix studio && npm run check --prefix web
scripts.install:clean: npm ci --prefix studio && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.lock:regenerate: rm -f studio/package-lock.json web/package-lock.json && npm install --package-lock-only --prefix studio && npm install --package-lock-only --prefix web
scripts.deps:update: npm update --prefix studio && npm update --prefix web
scripts.deps:update:patch: npm-check-updates -u --target patch --cwd studio && npm-check-updates -u --target patch --cwd web
